title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Know Exactly What You Owe

questions.text: According to the narration, if a debt statement does not show a minimum payment, how should you estimate it?
options: Two percent of the outstanding balance
Three percent of the outstanding balance
Five percent of the outstanding balance
Ten percent of the outstanding balance
questions.explanation: The narration advises estimating the minimum payment as roughly three percent of the outstanding balance when it is not listed.

questions.text: True or false: In the example debt snapshot, the total debt is TT$29,200 and the combined minimum monthly payment is TT$836.
questions.explanation: The narration explicitly states that the total debt across the four example debts is TT$29,200 and the combined minimum payment is TT$836.
